conclusion.interpretation: On two new layouts of known rough families, v16_control is top at 16s (177/300 strict six-tile) and history_high53 is top at 64s (236/300). Family leaders vary by terrain family/window, so evidence does not support a blanket global model-switching conclusion. This is unseen layout of known generator families, with correlated episodes within 2 maps and paired policies; it is not 1750 independent statistical examples nor evidence for novel-family transfer.
